sentences.en: WOMAN: Good morning. I'm doing a survey of shoppers in Broadbeach. Would you have a few minutes to spare to answer some questions?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 早上好。我正在Broadbeach开展一项购物者调查。您能否抽出几分钟时间回答几个问题？

sentences.en: MAN: Oh... erm... yes, I guess that would be ok.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦……嗯……是的，我想这应该没问题。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Thank you very much. Everybody seems so busy today.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 非常感谢。今天看起来每个人都很忙。

sentences.en: MAN: Well actually I don't have loads of time, so...
sentences.zh: MAN: 其实我并没有太多时间，所以……

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh yes, of course. It really won't take long. Could I start by taking your name please?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，是的，当然可以。真的不会花太久。我可以先记下您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Martyn Leigh. Martyn's with a Y.
sentences.zh: MAN: 马丁·利思。‘马丁’的拼写中用的是字母Y。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And is your family name spelt L-double-E?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您的姓氏拼写是L-双E吗？

sentences.en: MAN: It's L-E-1-G-H.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是L-E-I-G-H。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Thank you. We don't actually publish your name or details. It just makes it easier for me to identify people when I look at all the results at the end.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 谢谢。实际上我们并不会公开您的姓名或个人信息，只是在最后汇总所有调查结果时，便于我识别不同受访者。

sentences.en: MAN: I see.
sentences.zh: MAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And can I ask, how did you get into town today?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还想请问一下，您今天是怎么来镇上的？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, normally I catch the bus, but I'm on my motorbike today because I'm going to work later.
sentences.zh: MAN: 通常我乘公交车，但今天骑了我的摩托车，因为稍后我要去上班。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And could you tell me what you're doing this morning, I mean, the reason for your trip into town?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您能告诉我您今天上午来镇上的目的吗？也就是说，您这次进城的原因是什么？

sentences.en: MAN: I've just been to the hairdresser. You see, I have a job interview at the council in a few days.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我刚去理了发。您知道，几天后我要去市政厅参加一场工作面试。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh really! Well, good luck with that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，真的吗！祝您面试顺利！

sentences.en: MAN: Thanks a lot. And now I'm on my way to buy a suit that I can wear to the interview. I don't actually own one at the moment!
sentences.zh: MAN: 非常感谢！接下来我要去买一套面试时穿的西装——目前我手头还没有一套呢！

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK. Is that everything you're planning to do in town?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。您今天在镇上就只计划做这些事吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yeah. Well, I've got to go and pick up my @m.QR. It broke a couple of days ago so I took it to the shop to get it fixed. They had to order a spare part, but apparently it's ready for collection now. I can't wait to get it back.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的。不过我还得去取回我的@ m.QR。它几天前坏了，所以我送去店里维修；他们需要订购一个备用零件，但据说现在已修好、可以取回了。我真迫不及待想拿回来！

sentences.en: WOMAN: I'm sure. I hate it when my technology breaks down.... One more thing, it's Saturday today - is that when you like to do your shopping?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我完全理解。我的电子设备出故障时也特别烦人……还有一件事：今天是星期六——您通常喜欢选在周六购物吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Well it's more a question of when I'm free. If I'm free on a Monday. that's when I choose to come into town. The shops are less busy then, which I always prefer.
sentences.zh: MAN: 其实更多取决于我什么时候有空。如果周一有空，我就会选择那天进城购物。那时商店人比较少，我向来更喜欢这样。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So, I'd like to ask you a few more questions to get your views about shopping in Broadbeach, if that's ok.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，我想再问您几个问题，了解您对布罗德比奇购物的看法，可以吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Sure. What would you like to know specifically?
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以。您具体想了解些什么？

sentences.en: WOMAN: What would you say you like best about the shops here?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您觉得这里商店最吸引您的地方是什么？

sentences.en: MAN: I'd probably say it's the service you get wherever you go.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我大概会说是无论去哪家店都能享受到的优质服务。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK. And what do you think about the range of shops in Broadbeach?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。那么，您如何看待布罗德比奇的商铺种类？

sentences.en: MAN: Oh you can get almost anything you want here.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，您在这里几乎能买到任何想要的东西。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And what about recent changes? What do you like and dislike about them? For example, there are a lot of new coffee shops now, are you enjoying them?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么最近的变化呢？您喜欢和不喜欢哪些方面？例如，现在新增了许多咖啡馆，您喜欢它们吗？

sentences.en: MAN: No, there are too many of them. It's a shame as those places could be occupied by other kinds of shops.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不喜欢，咖啡馆实在太多了。这很可惜，因为这些店面本可以留给其他类型的商店。

sentences.en: WOMAN: What would you like to see instead?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那您希望看到什么替代方案呢？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, I think we have enough clothing shops. But there's only one place that sells books at the moment. It'd be nice to have a choice, you know.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我觉得目前服装店已经够多了。但眼下只有一家书店。要是能有更多选择就更好了，您知道吧。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right. And have you been to the new shopping centre outside Broadbeach yet, Martyn?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。马丁，您去过布罗德比奇外面那座新建的购物中心了吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, once or twice. It's not that far from where I live.
sentences.zh: MAN: 去过一两次。它离我家并不远。

sentences.en: WOMAN: It's a very modern-looking building, isn't it?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那是一座外观非常现代的建筑，对吧？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, and it's lovely. The glass roof is certainly impressive. But my favourite thing is the plants they've put around the building. They're amazing, and so big already.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，而且很漂亮。玻璃屋顶确实令人印象深刻。但我最喜欢的是环绕建筑布置的那些植物——它们太惊艳了，而且长得已经很大了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And what about the entertainment facilities? Have you used any of them yet?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那娱乐设施呢？您用过其中任何一项吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Like the new cinema?
sentences.zh: MAN: 比如那家新电影院？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Nah, not yet. I can't see any advantage in having it there because the one in town is actually bigger.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不，还没去过。我觉得建在那里没什么优势，因为镇上的那家电影院实际上更大。

sentences.en: OK, well thank you so much for...
sentences.zh: OK，那么非常感谢您……
